name: Wilmer Valderrama
bio: Wilmer Eduardo Valderrama (born January 30, 1980) is an American actor and television personality. He is known for his roles as Special Agent Nick Torres on the CBS series NCIS, Fez On the sitcom That '70s Show (1998–2006), Agustín Madrigal in Encanto, and Carlos Madrigal in From Dusk till Dawn: The Series (2014–2016). He was also host of the MTV series Yo Momma (2006–07), the voice of Manny in the children's show Handy Manny (2006–2013), and has had recurring roles on Grey's Anatomy as well as The Ranch (both in 2016).
